name: Mystic Alley
desc1: This is a wide, well-lit alleyway. It is very clean and well-kept, and
desc2: looks like it is regularly maintained. This is strange, since you can
desc3: see no apparent source of light, and as you look closer, you can see
desc4: not even the smallest particle of debris! The houses around you are
desc5: all tall and rickety-looking, and you could swear that some houses
desc6: just change places when you're not looking. There is a strange-looking
desc7: shop to the south, with a delicately-wrought glass door.
